title: Inventory Management Software Cost in India
seoTitle: Inventory Management Software Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What custom inventory and warehouse software costs in India: stock, batches, barcodes, multi-location, Tally sync. Cost bands, timelines and cost drivers.
summary: Custom inventory management software in India typically costs ₹5 lakh to ₹12 lakh for one warehouse with stock, barcodes and Tally sync, ₹12 lakh to ₹30 lakh for multiple locations with batches, expiry and a mobile scanning app, and more for full warehouse management with slotting and integrations with marketplaces.

body:
## What moves the price

- Batch, expiry or serial-number tracking.
- Multi-location transfers and approvals.
- Integrations with sales channels and accounts.
- Offline scanning in warehouses with weak connectivity.

See [inventory management software for distributors](/blog/inventory-management-software-for-distributors).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Can this replace inventory in Tally?
faqs.a: It can manage operational stock in detail while Tally keeps accounting stock values, synced daily or in real time.
Not always; modern phones scan barcodes well, though dedicated scanners are faster for high volumes.
